note: Doctor packs: what each doctor's programme adds on top of the shared data (step 2 of the plugin). Constraint layers merge strictest first: the doctor pack, then the patient's safety (allergies, conditions, medicines), then preferences (diet, avoid list). A pack can only add restrictions (never_foods, lower limits); it can never relax a patient's safety layer. approved_recipes are recipe IDs from the recipe collection that the doctor recommends: they are searched first and shown with the doctor's badge. DP-0.1.0 (26 Oct 2026): development pack only. The doctor has not reviewed it, so never_foods and limits are empty and the eight first recipes stand in for the doctor's list. Production refuses this file until the doctor signs it (approved_by, approved_on). DP-0.2.0 (26 Oct 2026): the eight stand-in recipes are gone (no doctor has picked recipes yet); recipe_books names the programme's Healthful Diet book, whose dishes are searched right after the doctor's own list. DP-0.3.0 (26 Oct 2026): a pack now carries everything that differs between doctors: the programme's identity (names used in wording), its own lines (texts), its rules (rules.data = a programme in manifest programme_rules, rules.rule_types = the rule types it switches on; any type left out behaves neutrally), recipe books, never-foods and limits. Everything else is shared by every doctor.

identity.name: Dixit programme
identity.app: the Dixit Lifestyle app, a food and meals programme used in India

texts.choice_intro: The Dixit programme doesn't ban foods. It changes how you eat, and some foods are worth choosing more often.
texts.explain_intro: Here's how the Dixit programme works:
texts.draft_meal_place: the home-cooked part of a Dixit meal (after nuts, salad and sprouts); a sabji or dal
texts.portion: I can't give amounts to eat or drink. In the programme you eat until you feel satisfied, not overfull, and finish each meal within 55 minutes. Ask your Dixit coach if you want to talk about amounts.
texts.plan_refusal: I can't write a meal plan or diet chart. The programme doesn't use fixed menus; this is how it works, and I can suggest dishes for a meal if you tell me what you have.
texts.frequency_note: The programme's position is two meals a day. I don't have approved evidence on other eating patterns to share here.
